title: endless loop for selectinload etc. for relationship to aliased class[

labels.name: great mcve
labels.description: An issue with a great mcve

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/9589

```py
from sqlalchemy import Column
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy import Integer
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import aliased
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


Base = declarative_base()


class A(Base):
    __tablename__ = "a"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)

    bs = relationship(lambda: B, lazy="selectin", back_populates="a")


class B(Base):
    __tablename__ = "b"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    a_id = Column(ForeignKey("a.id"))

    a = relationship(A, lazy="joined", back_populates="bs")


partitioned_b = aliased(B)

A.partitioned_bs = relationship(
    partitioned_b,
    lazy="selectin",
    viewonly=True
)


engine = create_engine("sqlite://", echo=True)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)


with Session(engine) as sess:
    a = A()
    a.bs = [B() for _ in range(5)]
    sess.add(a)

    sess.commit()


    results = sess.scalars(select(A))
    a = results.first()
    a.bs

```

this will load A.partitioned_bs over and over again without ending.

the contains_mapper() path check needs to look for aliased class.  This applies to 1.4 also:

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/path_registry.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/path_registry.py
index 4deb96b1f6..867d211e02 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/path_registry.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/path_registry.py
@@ -120,7 +120,7 @@ class PathRegistry(HasCacheKey):
 
     def contains_mapper(self, mapper):
         for path_mapper in [self.path[i] for i in range(0, len(self.path), 2)]:
-            if path_mapper.is_mapper and path_mapper.isa(mapper):
+            if (path_mapper.is_mapper and path_mapper.isa(mapper)): # or (path_mapper.is_aliased_class and path_mapper.mapper.isa(mapper)):
                 return True
         else:
             return False

```

milestone is 2.0.x but backport to 1.4 also
